notes_for_editor: Thin record. firelookout.com (one page) is the only history source: a cabin in the 1930s, half a mile below the summit on the north spur, listed as abandoned, with no year given for abandonment. The Association list gives the county, coordinates and Ground/Gone status, and the Forest Lookouts page gives only the legal location 25N-13W-35. No events are logged because the only date is the decade 1930s, and a year field would invent precision. No staffing, fires, access or current-condition sources were found in two websearch.py queries and about five page reads. The brief's record (gone, ground, Flathead County, coordinates) holds, so no corrections. The story is about 110 words, which is the thin-source length in the guide.
